suppress.notes: file name: jgroups-3.6.14.Final.jar Runtime Apache Geode dependency; largely depends on how the customer deploys it
file name: log4j-api-2.12.1.jar Will be filtered out at runtime by the actual dependency managed by dependabot

file name: geode-core-1.14.0.jar Many old false positive CVEs for http_server(CVE-2018-1303, CVE-2003-0789, CVE-2013-2249, CVE-2009-1890, CVE-2009-1891, CVE-2017-9798, CVE-2016-5387, CVE-2017-9788, CVE-2004-2343) which we actually don't even use.

This project is not affected as it't not using the vulnerable classes. https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24434#issuecomment-744519525. files: spring-beans-5.3.20.jar, spring-core-5.3.20.jar, spring-jcl-5.3.20.jar, spring-web-5.3.20.jar
5.3.39 is the latest version. To remediate this, a major version update would be needed, ie, Spring 6.x.x
Apache Geode support is still pinned to Spring Framework 5.3.39 in this build.

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

Shiro 2.2.1 is the latest 2.x release in Maven Central. CVE-2026-58301 is fixed only in 3.0.1, outside the minor/patch upgrade scope. The advisory affects shiro-jakarta-ee integration, which this cache integration does not include. Revisit when a major Shiro upgrade is permitted.

Spring Framework 5.3.39 is the latest public 5.x release in Maven Central. Patched 5.3.x releases require commercial access; no public minor/patch upgrade is available. Retain these release exceptions until a patched 5.x release becomes available or a major Spring migration is permitted.
CVE-2025-41234 is a false positive for Spring 5.3.39: the vendor advisory lists only 6.0.5-6.0.28, 6.1.0-6.1.20 and 6.2.0-6.2.7 as affected. https://spring.io/security/cve-2025-41234

HdrHistogram 2.2.2 is the latest release in Maven Central and both advisories affect versions through 2.2.2. No released minor/patch fix is available. These disputed local-attack findings remain release exceptions, not fixes. Revisit when a patched release becomes available.

LatencyUtils 2.0.3 is the latest release in Maven Central and is affected by this local-attack finding. No released minor/patch fix is available. Retain as a release exception and revisit when a patched release is published.
